channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Chile posts $1.69B trade surplus in August as copper exports fall
item.description: Chile's August trade surplus rose 8.8% year-on-year to $1.69 billion, but copper — the country's top export — slid to its lowest since July 2025.

item.title: Voter coalitions tested across key 2026 midterm battlegrounds
item.description: From Jewish Democratic defections to Latino realignment reversals, 2026 is stress-testing assumptions about who votes for whom and why.

item.title: Messi records two assists in MLS return after Argentina retirement
item.description: Messi delivered two assists in a 2-2 draw with Atlanta United on Saturday, his first club match since retiring from Argentina duty.

item.title: Salvadoran TPS set to expire Sept. 9, affecting over 170,000
item.description: USCIS has set a September 9 termination date for El Salvador's TPS, though DHS has yet to publish a formal determination.

item.title: Trump threatens to bar Bombardier from US market
item.description: President Trump threatened Monday to bar Bombardier from the US market unless the Canadian planemaker shifts manufacturing to American soil.

item.title: Sheinbaum vows to sustain social programs, says Mexico props up US economy
item.description: Sheinbaum locks in welfare spending at a record 1.3 trillion pesos and touts $35 billion in foreign investment despite US tariff pressure.

item.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on US goods take effect Sept. 8
item.description: Canada's counter-tariffs on roughly $19.9 billion USD in American goods began at 12:01 a.m. Tuesday, escalating a trade dispute that collapsed talks last month.

item.title: Costa Rica falls to Colombia in U-20 Women's World Cup opener
item.description: Sheika Scott gave Costa Rica an early lead, but Colombia leveled on a penalty to hand Las Ticas a 1-1 draw-turned-defeat in Poland.

item.title: Trump proposes renaming New Mexico 'New America' on social media
item.description: A viral hoax sparked a real presidential post, raising old questions about naming power, national identity, and how geography becomes politics.

item.title: Messi retires from Argentina after 21 years of international duty
item.description: At 39, Lionel Messi closes his Argentina chapter with 98 goals, 142 caps, and four major trophies across 21 years.

item.title: 2026 midterm campaigns enter final stretch on Labor Day
item.description: Labor Day 2026 opens the final sprint to November 3, with control of both chambers of Congress on the line.

item.title: Poitras ICE documentary 'They're Here' premieres at Venice
item.description: The 25-minute film, co-directed by Laura Poitras and Rachel Lauren Mueller, screened out of competition at the 83rd Venice Film Festival.

item.title: Messi and Atlanta's Junior Alonso clash after Miami's 2-2 draw
item.description: Messi confronted Junior Alonso after Atlanta's keeper denied a late equalizer, sparking a tunnel standoff that required players from both sides to intervene.

item.title: AfD wins Saxony-Anhalt state election but falls short of majority
item.description: The AfD won 43.8 percent in Saxony-Anhalt but fell three seats short of a majority, leaving coalition prospects uncertain.

item.title: Armed man lunges at Ohio Democratic governor candidate at fair
item.description: Patrick Havas, 38, was arrested Sunday after forcing his way through a crowd toward Amy Acton at the Canfield Fair, authorities said.

item.title: Rutinel resigns Colorado House seat to focus on CD-8 race
item.description: State Rep. Manny Rutinel stepped down from the Colorado House on Sept. 4 to concentrate on his bid to unseat Republican Rep. Gabe Evans in CD-8.

item.title: UN rights chief demands accountability for 23 migrant deaths in US custody
item.description: UN Human Rights chief Volker Türk told the Human Rights Council that 23 migrants have died in US immigration custody in 2026.

item.title: Trump administration files third Supreme Court appeal on USPS mail ballot rules
item.description: A third Supreme Court appeal in six weeks over mail-ballot rules reveals something deeper than a single election dispute.

item.title: Mexico and Brazil open 2026 U-20 Women's World Cup in Poland
item.description: Mexico drew 2-2 with Benín while Brazil crushed Tanzania 4-1 as the 2026 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup kicked off September 5 in Poland.

item.title: Three stabbed near Brooklyn's West Indian Day Parade on Labor Day
item.description: Three men were stabbed near Crown Heights before dawn Monday, hours ahead of the West Indian American Day Parade along Eastern Parkway.

item.title: New Hampshire and Rhode Island hold state primaries on Sept. 8
item.description: Voters in New Hampshire and Rhode Island head to the polls September 8 to select party nominees ahead of November general elections.

item.title: Israeli airstrikes kill at least 12 in southern Lebanon village
item.description: Israeli airstrikes on the southern Lebanese village of Kfar Rumman killed at least 12 people Monday, including children, amid renewed Israel-Hezbollah escalation.

item.title: Fireworks explosion at Mexico patron saint festival kills 10
item.description: A deadly blast at a Mexican patron saint festival echoes a long, unresolved tension between sacred tradition and the stubborn risks of artisanal pyrotechnics.

item.title: Mexico remittances fall amid US crackdown as fintech apps boom
item.description: Mexico's remittance income dropped to $61.79 billion in 2025, snapping an 11-year growth streak, while fintech apps gain ground under a new US tax.

item.title: Mateo Messi captains Inter Miami Academy to Naples Cup title
item.description: The 10-year-old scored five goals to spark a comeback from 1-4 down, lifting the U10 trophy at Paradise Coast Sports Complex.

item.title: Middle East war drives oil near $90, raising fuel costs in Argentina
item.description: Brent crude climbed from $62 to $90 a barrel since January, pushing gasoline up 27% and diesel up 23% at Argentine pumps.

item.title: AfD wins Saxony-Anhalt state election, falls short of majority
item.description: The AfD secured 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt on Sunday, winning 39 of 83 parliament seats but falling short of a governing majority.

item.title: Cruz Azul hosts Club América in Liga MX Apertura 2026 Clásico Joven
item.description: Club América rolls into Estadio Banorte on Saturday riding a perfect 5-0-1 mark, while Cruz Azul looks to even up a rivalry América still leads.

item.title: Argentina grain prices hit decade high as exports set record
item.description: Wheat hits USD 237.5 per tonne and total exports are on track to smash USD 103 billion, a national record.

item.title: US restricts government travel to Nogales, Mexico over unspecified threat
item.description: The U.S. Mission to Mexico has limited government personnel travel in Nogales, Sonora, to essential daytime movement, citing unspecified threat information.

item.title: Federal court revives expedited removals as Trump expands deportation reach
item.description: A federal appeals court cleared the way for nationwide expedited removals as the administration accelerates deportations of migrant children and expands third-country flight programs.

item.title: Toluca wins Leagues Cup 2026, first Liga MX title since 2021
item.description: Los Diablos Rojos shut out Monterrey 2-0 in Houston to claim the Leagues Cup and end Liga MX's five-year drought in the competition.

item.title: Amazon cargo plane overruns Miami runway, killing five
item.description: Prime Air Flight 7598 overran a runway at Miami International Airport Sunday afternoon, killing five people and injuring five others.

item.title: US fuel prices hit Labor Day record as Iran war crimps supply
item.description: AAA says regular gasoline averaged $4.14 a gallon heading into Labor Day 2026, topping the prior record as the Iran conflict continues to disrupt global oil supply.

item.title: Iran claims strike on US vessel in Strait of Hormuz; US denies it
item.description: Iran claimed Sunday it struck a U.S. unmanned vessel in the Strait of Hormuz; the U.S. military called the assertion a 'total lie.'

item.title: 2026 midterms enter final stretch with Congress control at stake
item.description: With Republicans holding a narrow House majority and Senate control in play, both parties are framing November 3 as a defining referendum on the Trump administration.

item.title: Aguirre backs Márquez to lead Mexico after World Cup exit
item.description: Aguirre endorsed Márquez as Mexico's next coach at a Fundación Telmex Telcel event days after El Tri's World Cup exit.

item.title: Tigres and Necaxa draw 1-1 in Liga MX Apertura 2026
item.description: Nahuel Guzmán's penalty save kept Tigres alive, but Vucetich's side stays 14th after dropping two points at home.

item.title: ICE arrests surge as majority of detainees lack criminal records
item.description: Federal arrest data contradicts administration claims as ICE sets consecutive monthly records exceeding 50,000 arrests.

item.title: Oil States Brasil wins Petrobras subsea maintenance contract
item.description: The Macaé-based firm locks in a three-year Petrobras deal covering inspection, maintenance and intervention for a wide range of subsea equipment.
